obernants.operator: U={(lang,word,text,result)} with result None or a catalog concept; R uses matching language/word and earliest maximum cue score. U\R excludes unrelated-language concepts, None for a nonempty sense set and a later tied maximum. Conditional exact specification target; no semantic disambiguation guarantee.

obernants.operator: For winning i, compatible texts satisfy every score inequality: strictly beat earlier candidates, tie or beat later ones. Preserve all strings meeting those inequalities; cues starting with the queried word never constrain a score. For None, sense set is empty regardless of text.

obernants.operator: A cue equal to word OR having word as prefix is excluded, even if linguistically a different word. Adding occurrences of an excluded cue changes no score unless it also matches another eligible cue; repeated occurrences of one eligible cue still contribute one per stored cue occurrence.
